summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the NEW manual webhook enable/disable toggle (Developers > Webhooks) and verification of exact fiat amounts in the dashboard 'Recent payments' widget, against the live preview (prod DB, SAFE MODE). ALL 5 requested scenarios PASS. 2-step merchant login (onarrival21@gmail.com) works; Developers page + Webhooks tab render; toggle starts OFF with the red auto-disabled banner; ON -> POST /api/company/webhook-reenable/1 200 + toast 'Webhook delivery re-enabled' + banner gone + subtext 'Active — events are sent to your company URL.'; OFF -> POST /api/company/webhook-disable/1 200 + toast 'Webhook delivery paused' + banner reappears with MANUAL copy ('You paused webhook deliveries to your company URL (since ...) ... per-request webhook URLs are unaffected.') + reason 'Manually paused by merchant' + subtext 'Paused — events are not being sent to your company URL.'; state persists across a full page reload. Recent payments rows render exact 2-decimal fiat ($24.70, $246.67, $117.80 with data-fiat-exact=1) and correctly prefix estimates with '≈' for rows lacking a stored usd_value.

issues: Toast component had NO data-testid and auto-hides after 4s — I added data-testid="app-toast" + data-severity to /app/Components/UI/Toast/index.tsx (testability only, no behaviour change).
The bottom-right toast overlaps/hides the Help & Support chat FAB while visible (cosmetic).
'Webhook delivery paused' toast renders with SUCCESS (green) styling; an info/neutral severity would read better for a pause action.
Redundant controls: while paused, both the banner's red 'Re-enable' button and the new toggle do the same thing. Acceptable, but consider hiding the banner button now that the toggle exists.
'This period' hero total renders as $1,105.9 (one decimal) while Recent payments now shows exact 2 decimals — inconsistent money formatting (outside the requested scope, reported for awareness).

critical_code_review_comments: WebhookConsoleSection: reenable/disable handlers optimistically set disabledInfo then re-fetch loadSettings() — good; failure path toasts an error and the subsequent loadSettings() would correct the optimistic state only on success. Consider reverting optimistic state in the catch block so a failed POST doesn't leave the toggle showing the wrong position until the next load.
The Switch is disabled while reenabling||disabling, preventing double-submit — good.

Manual-vs-auto banner copy is branched on reason.includes('manual'), i.e. it depends on the backend reason string containing 'Manually'. Brittle coupling — prefer an explicit backend flag (e.g. webhook_disabled_manual: boolean).
WebhookConsoleSection.tsx is ~790 lines and RecentTransactionsWidget.tsx ~785 lines — both above the 700-line guidance; consider splitting (settings vs events log; row renderer vs container).
